scope: The seventeen originals in the pre-staged final alirezarezvani batch, in index order.
identity_note: The parent verified SHA256 and Git blob identities before staging. This review read the guarded, host-scrubbed staging text; the parent must reconcile identities again.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references, scripts, services, and accounts were not accessed. Their contents and runtime behavior are not independently verified.

sources.workflow: Route to one project-management skill, or run the bounded observe, choose, act, verify, record and stop delivery loop.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A delivery goal and authority; router and selected skill; for the live loop, authenticated Atlassian access, current Jira data, bridge, gates and harness; named human owner and reviewer.
sources.offline_assessment: The routing and governance contract can be analyzed from supplied text or snapshots, but that is not a live delivery loop or verified closure.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer must inspect gate results, task evidence and the close handoff against the acceptance criteria; human ownership and approvals also require confirmation.

sources.workflow: Route to one product skill or run the recurring discovery loop, with cadence tracking, opportunity-tree linting and escalation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product decision ownership, a defined outcome, discovery log and tree, router and selected tools; at least two interviews for cadence scoring; applicable plugins and harness for their lanes.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied log and tree permit a bounded structural review; they do not establish that interviews, tests, or product outcomes occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently compare the cadence report and tree-lint verdict with the underlying log and tree; interview quality and product decisions require human judgment.

sources.workflow: Govern quality through management reviews, KPI and objective tracking, culture assessment and regulatory oversight.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual QMS records and process-owner inputs, required attendees, accountable QMR and management, baseline data and current applicable requirements; executive approval for objectives.
sources.offline_assessment: Provided records can support a gap analysis or draft review package, not an actual management review or compliance determination.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An authorized quality or regulatory reviewer must check review records, decisions and signatures against actual QMS evidence and current applicable requirements; compliance judgment is human-dependent.

sources.workflow: Verify the cause, observe a failing behavioral test, make the smallest fix, observe green, revert the fix and observe red again, restore it and run the broader suite.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A specific defect, evidence of its cause, relevant code and executable test environment; the same focused command and assertions across phases.
sources.offline_assessment: Source and existing evidence can be reviewed for gaps, but without observed runs and code changes no red-green-red proof exists.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can inspect the code states, unchanged assertions and recorded red, green, revert-red and restored-suite outputs; cause attribution may still require judgment.

sources.workflow: Pause the current thread, reread the conversation, assess direction, gaps, questions, biases and alignment, then recommend continue, pivot or pause.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Enough prior conversational context to reassess, or one clarifying question when context is thin.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied conversation is sufficient for a bounded reasoning-based reflection; conclusions remain interpretive.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reader can compare cited conversation evidence and the final recommendation with the full conversation; bias and direction judgments are interpretive.

sources.workflow: Summarize supplied sources, compare two to five where requested, extract citations and check finding locations, quality ratings and bibliography counts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: User-supplied readable documents; at least two for comparison; citation extractor and source text for the stated count check.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied document can be summarized offline; without the extractor run its required citation-count verification is unobserved.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reader can check each finding against its source location and reconcile the extractor count with the bibliography; quality ratings remain interpretive.

sources.workflow: Select an audience and roadmap format, draft roadmap or release communications, and optionally generate a changelog from a Git range.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual roadmap or release facts, audience and timing; repository history and generator for Git-based changelogs.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft can be prepared from supplied facts; it does not demonstrate release, stakeholder communication or changelog generation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can compare the draft or changelog with approved roadmap facts and the specified Git range; audience suitability and approval are human-dependent.

sources.workflow: Frame the idea, run five parallel reviewers including a market investigator, synthesize their scores and tensions, and prescribe the cheapest 48-hour test.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Idea, buyer and revenue model, founder edge and constraints; five reviewer runs, market evidence, synthesizer and test-design tooling.
sources.offline_assessment: A first-principles critique can be bounded offline; it is not the prescribed independent panel, market investigation or validated customer demand.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can check the five panel outputs, market evidence and synthesis against the shared brief; customer demand requires an actual test and human interpretation.

sources.workflow: Define up to three variables, map cross-functional and cascading impacts, model three severity levels, set early warnings and assign hedges.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete scenario with estimated probabilities and timelines, business baselines and relevant functional inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A conditional cascade and sensitivity analysis can be drafted from supplied assumptions; it does not establish actual probabilities or implement hedges.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can recalculate scenario impacts and trace the cascade to supplied assumptions; probabilities, causal judgments and hedge feasibility require domain-owner judgment.

sources.workflow: Analyze velocity, sprint health and retrospective actions, then use the results in planning, ceremonies and team-development interventions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Mapped sprint JSON; at least three sprints for velocity, two with ceremony and completion data for health, and three retrospectives for full retrospective analysis.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied records permit partial analysis within their coverage; thin or missing data are limitations, not measured failure.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can check input completeness and recalculate reported metrics from sprint and retrospective records; team health and interventions require contextual human judgment.

sources.workflow: Assess portfolio health, risk and capacity, escalate threshold breaches, and synthesize executive reporting and periodic strategic reviews.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Current portfolio, financial, risk and resource data; analysis tools; sponsor and stakeholders for escalation and decisions.
sources.offline_assessment: A provided snapshot supports conditional calculations and reporting drafts; it does not verify live portfolio status or execute reallocations.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can reconcile health, risk and capacity outputs with current portfolio records and check escalation evidence; reallocation decisions require authorized people.

sources.workflow: Test strategy articulation, map the goal cascade, identify orphan goals, conflicts, gaps and silos, then workshop realignment and quarterly checks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Company strategy and goals at each level, responses from five people across teams, organizational context and participation by goal owners and department leads.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied goals can be checked for apparent structural gaps; actual shared understanding, incentives and realignment require people and organizational evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can trace mapped goals to company objectives and inspect workshop decisions; shared understanding, conflicts and incentive changes require human participation and judgment.

sources.workflow: Approximately assess CEFR level, build a listening, reading, writing and speaking path, recommend suitable specific resources and set a next milestone.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Learner goals, level or assessment answers and language preference; vetted catalog or learner-supplied resources for direct recommendations.
sources.offline_assessment: A provisional practice plan can use supplied learner information; resource availability and formal proficiency are not established.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A qualified reviewer can compare the plan with learner responses and check recommended resources for suitability and availability; informal placement is interpretive, not a certified assessment.

sources.workflow: Collect syllabus, audience and year range; group and confirm topics; search Consensus sequentially; select papers, write calibrated summaries and questions, generate and validate a document.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Readable syllabus, audience and date range, explicit grouping confirmation, Consensus connection, returned paper metadata, Node and the document package.
sources.offline_assessment: Syllabus parsing and provisional topic grouping are possible offline; they cannot substitute for session search results or the generated and validated reading list.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can reconcile cited papers with session results and audit counts, inspect document integrity and required sections, and review audience fit; educational quality requires human judgment.

sources.workflow: Route to the matching communication reference, gather factual context, confirm scope and audience, draft in that format and request feedback.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The matching reference template, factual source material and confirmed audience and period; connected tools are optional if the user supplies context.
sources.offline_assessment: A fact-grounded draft is possible with supplied context and template; no connected service or publication is required for that fallback.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can compare the draft with the selected template and supplied facts; audience fit and final wording require human feedback.

sources.workflow: Generate and export design tokens, define components and responsive behavior, check accessibility and prepare developer handoff.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Brand color, style and target formats; token generator and project context; design tooling and integration access where synchronization is required.
sources.offline_assessment: Token and component specifications can be assessed from supplied values; this does not prove generated artifacts, accessibility compliance or design-tool synchronization.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent reviewer can inspect exported tokens, test component states and contrast, and check handoff and synchronization evidence; visual and usability assessment also needs human judgment.

sources.workflow: Scan open loops, process inboxes, review actions, calendars, waiting items and projects, then review possibilities, audit commitments and name a next action.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Accessible notes and commitment records, calendar and list context, user participation, scanner, checklist gate and auditor.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied records can support a partial inventory; an unrun gate or missing personal context cannot establish a completed review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The checklist gate must issue the completion verdict from recorded steps and skips; the person must confirm that personal lists, calendars and commitments were actually reviewed.

schema_correction_note: The agent supplied concrete verifier descriptions in a same-task correction. All other fields preserve its original response exactly.
source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
